title: Bastion: a governed agent fleet for Google Cloud IAM review (source code, v0.9.2)
description:
Source code of Bastion, a three-agent fleet that reviewed Google Cloud IAM access with deterministic policy authority, explicit agent handoffs and completion confirmations. v0.9.2 is a source-only release and was never deployed; the final deployment, evaluated in the technical report, was v0.9.1. The fleet was retired on 9 November 2026.

Technical report: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24120596
